description: Downtown Oakland Off-street Parking Facilities is a dataset listed in City of Oakland open data portal (data.oaklandca.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Oakland. Offstreet inventory and occupancy counts for Jack London and Downtown Oakland. Current as of July 2019. Coverage: Oakland. The portal files it under the category Infrastructure. Its tags are parking. The table has 20 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Oakland Department of Transportation. The portal shows 2019-12-09 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-oaklandca-gov-portal.
